no_plaintext_secrets.description: API keys, access tokens, and sensitive credentials must never be committed to repository code, configuration files, or logs. Use environment variables or secure credential storage.

command_execution_guardrails.description: System commands executed via automation or LLM tools must be sanitized, bounded, and audited. Arbitrary unrestricted shell execution without validation is prohibited.

least_privilege_access.description: File system operations, IPC, and network socket access must be scoped strictly to the minimum required workspace directories and ports.

unidirectional_dependencies.description: Subsystem dependencies must flow cleanly: UI/VOICE -> SERVICES -> CORE -> MODELS. Circular imports across layers are strictly prohibited.

adr_requirement_for_level_2_and_3.description: Any change altering subsystem contracts, introducing new dependencies, or deprecating existing APIs must register an ADR in docs/decisions/.

service_encapsulation.description: Internal implementation details of SERVICES (e.g. MemoryService, ProviderManager) must be encapsulated behind clean interface contracts.

decision_ladder_enforcement.description: Always follow the ladder: (1) Do nothing / eliminate -> (2) OS/Platform native -> (3) Python stdlib -> (4) Existing workspace packages -> (5) Minimal third-party library.

yagni_anti_bloat.description: Strict prohibition of speculative features, premature abstractions, empty interface boilerplate, and multi-layer wrappers.

zero_dead_code.description: No commented-out code, orphaned functions, unused imports, or zombie modules may remain in the active codebase.

surgical_diff_control.description: Changes must be scoped to the minimal contiguous block necessary. Mass reformatting, gratuitous whitespace churn, and unnecessary file rewrites are rejected.

explicit_assumptions.description: State all assumptions regarding inputs, dependencies, and environment behavior before writing code, and verify them through tangible runtime proof.

documentation_integrity.description: Preserve all existing docstrings, explanatory comments, and contracts unless their behavior is deliberately being modified.

tdd_verification_proof.description: Every logic modification or feature addition must be accompanied by automated tests in TESTS/ with command invocation logs proving green status.

disk_externalized_state.description: Multi-step operations must anchor their state to PRD.md and progress.txt on disk to withstand context eviction or session restarts.

contextual_caller_verification.description: AST-aware caller and consumer analysis must confirm that no downstream component is broken by signature or behavioral alterations.
